question: Which of L11H3's two bilinear query/key branches routes the command-specific values from the locked temporal-bridge and is-was-postcue source regions?

terms: L11H3 q k q2 k2 factorial
prior_art_search.closest: task14_head11_3_ood_fronted_self_qk_factorial_v1 is a 16-corner algebra precedent on a different task and self-source term. It did not test the temporal/is-was H4 program, the bridge/postcue source regions, or value-source transfer.
prior_art_search.novelty: First exact four-factor routing screen conditioned on the causally identified L11H3 value reader and its two prospectively locked semantic source regions.

frozen_design.populations: Use every 128 endpoint in the original and fresh OOD banks. Preserve phase, template, cell, group, and exact command-counterfactual pairings. Temporal source is locked to bridge; is-was source is locked to postcue. No source reselection is allowed.
frozen_design.corners: For each role, keep donor L11H3 c_v installed at the locked source positions in every arm. Evaluate all 16 masks over q,k,q2,k2. Donor q/q2 slices are installed only at the role answer query; donor k/k2 slices are installed only at the locked source positions. Mask 0000 is the licensed selected-value parent and 1111 is the full donor-routing corner.
frozen_design.algebra: Compute the exact four-factor Mobius expansion and Shapley vectors of the 0000-to-1111 downstream command-margin response. Require reconstruction error <=1e-8. These are interventions on the multilinear extension; q versus k labels are descriptive until a natural-counterfactual confirmation passes.
frozen_design.fit_selection: On pooled original FIT separately by role, order factors by descending Shapley-vector L2 norm with fixed q,k,q2,k2 tie order. Select the shortest prefix whose norm mass is at least 80 percent of total. If the full-routing delta norm is below 10 percent of the 0000 parent norm, report routing_invariant and select no factor.
frozen_design.validation: Without reselection, the selected-mask delta must recover at least .50 of the full-routing delta with cosine >=.80 and direction agreement >=.75 on original HOLDOUT and both OOD phases. The 0000 value parent must reproduce the audit-recovered localization validations to 1e-5.
frozen_design.shared_partner: The two roles share a routing partner only if their selected factor sets are identical and both validate. Otherwise preserve task-typed routing or a stable routing-invariant result.
frozen_design.selectivity: Every 0000/selected/1111 panel has cross-role/gold norm <=.01; is-was arms change the earlier temporal margin by <=1e-5.

predictions.pred_a_authority_pairing_parent_replay_f: All authorities, locked regions, 16-corner coverage, hook counts, 0000 parent replay, finiteness, and literal price pass.
predictions.pred_b_four_factor_mobius_and_shapley_ac: Every response vector reconstructs to <=1e-8 and Shapley efficiency holds.
predictions.pred_c_fit_selected_routing_partner_vali: Every non-invariant role's original-FIT-selected factor subset passes all frozen validation bars without reselection; an invariant role satisfies the registered small-delta clause everywhere.
predictions.pred_d_temporal_and_iswas_share_one_rout: Both roles are non-invariant and select the same q/k factor subset, which validates everywhere.
predictions.pred_e_routing_factorial_is_task_selecti: All collateral and later-to-earlier causal-zero bars pass.

null: If A or B fails, the instrument is invalid. If C fails, the q/k factor identity is not stable and no partner is claimed. If D alone fails, preserve separate task-typed routing partners. A routing-invariant terminal means native value transfer does not require command-varying q/k factors under this paired intervention; it does not mean attention routing is absent.
decision: A/B/C/E with D true identifies a shared routing-factor subset for the two task-typed values. A/B/C/E with D false identifies stable task-typed routing or routing invariance. Either result sharpens the L11H3 computation before extraction; it does not reopen DAS, source positions, or L15 q/q2.
